review_basis: All nine GitHub Actions Chromium PNGs were visually inspected at player height. This review rejects scene semantics; it is not derived from build success, telemetry, file presence or image metrics.

frame_reviews.finding: The player is correctly standing on Yard Roof, but roughly two-thirds of the image is clear blue/white sky. Huge muddy-brown side facades, a black lower sill and amber slab-like threshold shapes still create a prototype corridor, not an industrial exterior vista.
A single giant stained facade fills the right side while sky remains dominant. Tiny teal rectangles and lamps do not make it a believable occupied building or reveal a lower harbour/city layer.
The west look repeats the terminal frame with a sparse brown building and oversized amber steps. The distant ridge is only a thin pale strip, not a legible destination world.
The capture truthfully records a navigation miss: player position remains near Dispatch Bay. Visually it is another high-sky view over generic ramps, not a Switch House arrival.
A second early-route frame is incorrectly named as a beacon context by intent only. It contains no verified transfer arrival and no clear player-facing route choice.
This is still Dispatch Bay geometry. The image does not show an East Span runway, supported viaduct, speed cue, branch choice or landing.

The player is airborne below authored support at the recorded position and the sequence subsequently restarts. It is not valid transfer evidence; the image still has the same empty-sky/giant-facade presentation.
The visible Checkpoint reset toast and support contact on Yard Roof prove this is a recovery after a failed transfer, not Boiler Court arrival.
This final claimed Boiler Court look is visibly Dispatch Bay again. It cannot be used for later-region approval or whole-run coverage.

role_reviews.finding: The updated physical sky replaces beige with blue, but the image is still overwhelmingly sky-first and has no dramatic silhouette hierarchy. Mud-brown facades, black bands and orange slabs are not a controlled highline art direction.
role_reviews.required_action: Compose a first 20-second hero image around an open roof threshold, a framed terminal, high-value adjacent structures and a dense but readable low harbour horizon; make amber a sparing signal colour.

role_reviews.finding: Only Dispatch Bay has grounded-contact evidence. The scripted run does not reach Switch House, East Span or Boiler Court, so choices, transitions and region pacing are unreviewable.
role_reviews.required_action: Correct input-heading calibration, make the first circulation connection plainly traversable, and stop each capture only on an authored support surface in the intended region.

role_reviews.finding: The world is still an obstacle course flanked by broad, undifferentiated textured boxes. The thin grey ridge and small teal windows do not supply facade depth, industrial logic, a lower world, or a believable harbour context.
role_reviews.required_action: Replace unarticulated wall faces with bays, recesses, service floors, roof equipment and structural edges. Add central low-rise/distant building masses and rail/harbour silhouettes that are visible through the route frame.

role_reviews.finding: The `Sky` helper produces a physically graded background, but browser automation entered the run looking steeply upward: capture directions have Y approximately +0.458. Console also records two 404 requests and expected screenshot ReadPixels stalls.
role_reviews.required_action: Use feedback-controlled real mouse alignment before capture, resolve the 404 source, retain ReadPixels warning only as capture overhead, and retest actual camera directions in CI.

role_reviews.finding: The player sees orange planar thresholds and a terminal, not take-off/landing geometry or a compelling speed transfer. The active capture route falls below support before reaching the East Span.
role_reviews.required_action: Use shallow supported stairs and visible landings; separate safety paint from traverse surface mass; make the East dash landing physically and visually clear before presenting it as a set piece.

role_reviews.finding: A residual automation mouse movement forces the initial view approximately 27 degrees upward, defeating the intended slight down-facing default. Travel input then moves diagonally off the primary line.
role_reviews.required_action: Calibrate route heading and pitch from the real probe direction with bounded pointer-lock mouse movement; never set player/camera coordinates. Record the resulting direction in every capture.

role_reviews.finding: The terminal is visible but the composition neither promises a route nor sells a place worth exploring. The recovery toast confirms the route attempt failed rather than making failure legible or satisfying.
role_reviews.required_action: Make the first route step, destination, skyline and recovery line readable without the HUD; add one memorable distant industrial landmark.

role_reviews.finding: The two screenshot-driven GPU ReadPixels stalls are not gameplay FPS evidence. The current world nevertheless spends large screen area on plain high-poly? unarticulated walls rather than a few value-rich silhouette assemblies.
role_reviews.required_action: Profile after facade reconstruction; consolidate repeated facade detail where possible and do not use capture stalls as an FPS verdict.

role_reviews.finding: This is still a failed visual build. Blue sky replaces beige, yet it remains mostly sky, brown boxes, black occluding strips, teal window slots and orange obstacle slabs. Six claimed later-region frames are demonstrably false route evidence.
role_reviews.required_action: Reject the batch. Repair first-person orientation and route navigation, rebuild the dispatch composition around credible built layers, then recapture all views for a fresh review.

critical_defects.title: Sky-dominant camera composition remains a critical visual defect
critical_defects.fix: Align capture pitch downward from actual pointer-lock direction and rebuild central/low vista layers; do not consider a gradient sky sufficient environment work.

critical_defects.title: Dispatch is built from giant repeated box/facade masses
critical_defects.fix: Replace oversized flat wall read with constructed facade bays, roof detail, voids/recesses, legible structural support and an open threshold.

critical_defects.title: Amber threshold geometry still reads as oversized obstacle slabs
critical_defects.fix: Use thin nosings/stripe marks only; open actual parapet gaps and let dark roof/stair material define circulation.

critical_defects.title: Real-input capture falls off course after Dispatch
critical_defects.fix: Use real-mouse feedback orientation and grounded authored-support verification. Preserve navigation misses rather than relabelling them.

approval_rule: The 33962715816 batch is CAPTURED and INSPECTED but not APPROVED. Diagnostic scores are supplied only for the three genuinely arrived Dispatch frames. No score is fabricated for navigation-miss frames, and this review does not authorize a completion claim.
